global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage overlooking an electronics display table where a synthetic subject takes a boxed smartphone and hides it under their jacket.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands at a retail display table, holding a white rectangular smartphone box with both hands at waist height while examining the product.
The subject swiftly moves the box upward toward their chest, using both hands to push the box directly inside the front opening of their plaid jacket.
The subject withdraws their hands, adjusting the outer fabric of their plaid jacket to ensure the box is fully covered, and stands casually at the table with empty hands.
